LSPV-5/REFEREE390 (2026-11-06 09:48 PST) narrows the remaining 35-node mixed bridge class.

**PROVED/RESTRICTED + COMPUTATIONAL:** exact historical RES+AND3+XOR source-once closure of each authenticated 18-source side yields 1,888 full-source clauses, five non-affine factors, and zero affine equations. Across all subsets, the only 15 affine-producing source sets are exactly the nonempty unions of the four complete internal four-clause parity bundles; neither boundary source occurs in one. Therefore a side cannot be partitioned into affine blocks.

Consequently every legal 35-node proof, if one exists, must contain an AND3-produced factor/equation whose source ancestry crosses the one-variable cut. Empty-clause root would force an all-RES proof, already excluded by REFEREE389. The complete 12-item row-respecting quotient (eight authenticated internal rows plus four boundary clauses) also has no full-source outcome.

Primary enumeration performed 1,126,097,195 RES, 55,144 AND3 and 25 XOR pair tests per side. A separate base-3 implementation reproduced every count and the exact 15-subset classification and rejected six hostile mutations. No authoritative historical accepted-byte checker was run.

Scope remains strict: a cross-cut block may split an internal parity bundle or feed a cross-cut RES clause into AND3. That class and all 36-node classes remain OPEN, so $35\le W_{R_{\rm mix341}}(F_{\rm bridge})\le37$ is unchanged. Full mixed superpolynomial growth, B1/B2/B3 and P versus NP remain OPEN.
